checks.detail: RenderPlan binds exact conformed timeline, audio, ASS, platform, toolchain, operation cache keys and checksum.
Technical, Rights and Offline Quality blockers aggregate without score compensation.
Release requires human release_approver, first-wins exact target and DB-first publication.
No real fully conformed E10 input exists for final FFmpeg render and proxy/final parity.
Full decode, sync, loudness, black/freeze/silence, subtitle geometry and platform upload checks await final media.
No complete real release asset manifest has been supplied and cleared.
No real candidate has been blind-reviewed against the demo rubric and timecoded evidence.
No real FinalCandidate has received human Gate 3 approval.

severe_errors.description: Rendered candidate cannot decode completely or violates required container/codec profile.
Final output materially differs from approved proxy geometry, timing, audio or subtitles.
Release package lacks cleared rights for any used asset.
Final candidate contains a material story, identity, temporal or causal error.
Dialogue or narration is materially masked or unintelligible.
Rendered subtitle or graphic obscures key visual evidence.
A service, model or router attempts to approve Release Gate.
